name: Cypris
tagline: AI R&D and innovation intelligence over patents and research.
description: An enterprise R&D and innovation-intelligence platform that aggregates patents, scientific literature, market data, and grants into a searchable AI workspace. Built for research and IP teams doing technology scouting, competitive analysis, freedom-to-operate assessments, and landscape reports.
insight: Operated by IP Web, Inc.; founded 2019, raised a $5.3M round led by Vocap Partners in 2024 (~$14M total).
edge: Purpose-built on structured patent + scientific-literature data for technology scouting and freedom-to-operate, rather than a general-purpose chatbot.
pros: Built for R&D, IP, and FTO workflows
Combines patents, literature, and market data
cons: Aimed at IP/R&D teams, not casual research
